name: restraint
description: Observes developer activity and decides when (rarely) to speak.

restraint.autoStart.description: Start the capture engine and judge when VS Code starts.

restraint.redaction.enabled.description: Strip secrets (key/token/password string literals, .env contents) before anything leaves the editor process.

restraint.python.description: Python executable for the capture engine and judge. Empty = auto-detect (.venv/venv in the extension folder, then python3, python, py).

restraint.port.description: Port for the local candidate-moment endpoint.

restraint.testSurface.enabled.description: TEMPORARY: show judge decisions from logs/*.jsonl as notifications and in the status bar. Testing only.

restraint.prompt.description: Judge prompt version passed to judge.live (see judge/prompts.py). Empty = the judge's default.

restraint.perHour.description: Interruption budget: at most this many interventions per hour.

restraint.verbose.description: Log every raw editor event to the Restraint output channel (noisy).
